"""Jedna diagnostyka noty System pośrodku historii; wyłącznie własny lokalny serwer i syntetyczne dane."""
import datetime, hashlib, http.client, json, os, secrets, socket, subprocess, threading, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/scratch/defect-closure')
previous = json.loads((root/'core-receipts-candidate/status.json').read_text())
assert previous['state'] == 'completed', 'do not compete with active model'
out = root/'raw-qwen35-ledger-middle-ping10'
entry=json.loads((root/'qwen35-entry.json').read_text())
assert json.loads((root/'qwen35-download-resume-http1/status.json').read_text()).get('verification')=='MATCH'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
server = Path('/workspace/tools/llama/llama-b11559/llama-server')
assert hashlib.sha256(server.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '16c4e5fc3e0a74400033d958722e487a797dbb51c676f5ce1ec9066f1673efd5'
with socket.socket() as sock:
    sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0)); port = sock.getsockname()[1]
auth = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)  # Utworzony wyłącznie na czas tej próby; bez odczytu kont/CLI.
args = [str(server), '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', str(port), '-m',
        str(Path('/workspace/models')/entry['file']), '-c', '8192', '-ngl', '0',
        '--threads', '4', '-np', '1', '--jinja', '--alias', entry['id'], '--chat-template-kwargs', '{"enable_thinking":false}', '--sse-ping-interval', '10', '--api-key', auth]
status = {'start':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope':'raw HTTP diagnostic outside Core, synthetic prior ledger; no physical actions',
          'comparison_scope':'Qwen3.5-9B UnslothQ4 candidate; original V1 middleSystem3, same syntheticdata, no physical actions; rawonly, notCore/GPU acceptance',
          'change':'Qwen3.5-9B compared to V1 Qwen3-8B middleSystem inputs; same ping10, 96/temp0 and 60/30/120; raw diagnostic only',
          'model':entry, 'startup_budget_s':60, 'max_tokens':96, 'temperature':0, 'first_event_s':60, 'idle_s':30, 'turn_s':120,
          'server_args':[('<ephemeral-test-auth-redacted>' if x == auth else x) for x in args],
          'results':[], 'state':'starting'}
def save():
    p=out/'status.tmp';p.write_text(json.dumps(status,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');os.replace(p,out/'status.json')
def connection():
    return http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=2)
def log_server(stream):
    with (out/'server.log').open('w') as log:
        for line in iter(stream.readline, b''):
            log.write(line.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').replace(auth,'<ephemeral-test-auth-redacted>'))
            log.flush()

process = None; boot=time.monotonic(); save()
try:
    process=subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    status.update(pid=process.pid, group=process.pid)
    status['birth']=Path(f'/proc/{process.pid}/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]
    thread=threading.Thread(target=log_server,args=(process.stdout,),daemon=True);thread.start();save()
    while True:
        if process.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError('own server exited during startup')
        try:
            c=connection();c.request('GET','/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+auth})
            r=c.getresponse();r.read();ready=r.status==200;c.close()
            if ready:break
        except OSError:pass
        if time.monotonic()-boot>60:raise TimeoutError('startup60s')
        time.sleep(.25)
    status.update(load_ms=round((time.monotonic()-boot)*1000),state='running');save()
    original=json.loads((root/'core-receipts-candidate/responses.json').read_text())['results'][:3]
    source=[dict(case, placement='middle') for case in original]
    for case in source:
        req=case['provider_request'];notes=[];messages=[]
        if req.get('system') is not None:notes.append(req['system'])
        for m in req['messages']:
            assert all(b['type']=='text' for b in m['content'])
            text=''.join(b['text'] for b in m['content'])
            if m['role']=='system' and case['placement']=='merged':notes.append(text)
            else:messages.append({'role':m['role'],'content':text})
        body={'model':entry['id'],'messages':[{'role':'system','content':'\n\n'.join(notes)}]+messages,
              'max_tokens':96,'temperature':0,'stream':True,'stream_options':{'include_usage':True}}
        (out/(case['placement']+'-'+case['scenario']+'-request.json')).write_text(json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
        result={'placement':case['placement'],'scenario':case['scenario'],'text':'','first_visible_since_http_ms':None,
                'first_visible_since_server_start_ms':None,'error':None,'chunks':[],'finish_reasons':[],'usage':None}
        start=time.monotonic();last=start;seen=False;buffer=b'';done=False
        c=connection()
        try:
            c.timeout=60;c.request('POST','/v1/chat/completions',json.dumps(body).encode(),
                headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+auth})
            r=c.getresponse();result['http_status']=r.status
            if r.status!=200:
                result['error_body']=r.read(8192).decode('utf-8',errors='replace').replace(auth,'<ephemeral-test-auth-redacted>')
                raise RuntimeError('HTTP'+str(r.status))
            while not done:
                now=time.monotonic(); deadline=min(start+120,last+30 if seen else start+60)
                if now>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('transport deadline; no retry')
                c.sock.settimeout(deadline-now)
                chunk=r.read1(65536)
                if not chunk:break
                now=time.monotonic();seen=True;last=now
                result['chunks'].append({'ms':round((now-start)*1000),'bytes':len(chunk)})
                buffer+=chunk
                while b'\n' in buffer:
                    line,buffer=buffer.split(b'\n',1)
                    if not line.startswith(b'data:'):continue
                    payload=line[5:].strip()
                    if payload==b'[DONE]':done=True;break
                    data=json.loads(payload)
                    if data.get('usage') is not None:result['usage']=data['usage']
                    for choice in data.get('choices',[]):
                        if choice.get('finish_reason') is not None:result['finish_reasons'].append(choice['finish_reason'])
                        text=choice.get('delta',{}).get('content') or ''
                        if text:
                            if result['first_visible_since_http_ms'] is None:
                                result['first_visible_since_http_ms']=round((now-start)*1000)
                                result['first_visible_since_server_start_ms']=round((now-boot)*1000)
                            result['text']+=text
        except (OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError) as error:result['error']=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
        finally:c.close()
        result['elapsed_ms']=round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000)
        result['http_first_visible_within60s']=result['first_visible_since_http_ms'] is not None and result['first_visible_since_http_ms']<=60000
        status['results'].append(result);save()
        print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        if result['error']:break
except (OSError,RuntimeError) as error:
    status['error']=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
finally:
    if process and process.poll() is None:
        process.terminate()
        try:process.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait();status['cleanup']='own process SIGTERM thenSIGKILL'
    if process:status['server_exit']=process.returncode
    status.update(state='completed',end=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
    save()
